verdict.rationale: Canva's Apps SDK brings new design and editing experiences into the editor, including importing content, adding elements and automating tasks. Apps can be published publicly through an Apps Marketplace, with a monetization path and a CLI for building apps, so marketplace-based editor extensibility is clearly documented. missing for 10: evidence of the marketplace's size or community breadth, concrete examples of icon, data-filler or accessibility-checker apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
